root_cause.text: The async AH completion callbacks fail to account for the 4-byte ESN seqhi slot that is prepended to the ICV/auth_data area during async ahash setup when ESN is enabled, causing them to calculate incorrect buffer offsets and operate on wrong bytes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that when ESN is enabled (`x->props.flags & XFRM_STATE_ESN`), the setup path allocates a 4-byte seqhi slot before the ICV or auth_data area, but the async completion callbacks (ah_output_done, ah_input_done, ah6_output_done, ah6_input_done) were reconstructing the temporary buffer layout without accounting for this slot. The fix adds `seqhi_len` calculation and passes it to the helper functions to skip the seqhi slot before locating auth_data or ICV. The CVE description demonstrates the offset mismatch: pre-fix callbacks calculated `icv_off=20` when the correct value was `expected_off=24` (a 4-byte difference matching the seqhi slot size).
